because.label: What it is
because.value: What the players on the club's major-league roster (active or on the injured list) are expected to add over the rest of 2040, in wins above replacement (WAR), added up. The first figure is the most likely; the range under it is what it could be. Players are combined as if their seasons didn't depend on each other, so the range is a reasonable reading, not a promise. It's who is there now, not who might arrive; a player whose production can't be projected is left out and named.

because.label: How it adds up
because.value: Expected wins above replacement on the major-league roster for the rest of 2040, summed over 26 players; players combined as independent; not a calibrated interval: around the sum of each player's most likely wins, each player's own distance from his combined across players. Every player at his edge: −6.3 to 18.7 wins.
